subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers revive the open conflicting fork PR for this Feishu receive-id bug, or close it and replace it with a fresh focused fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-supported, but an open cross-repository PR with closing syntax already claims the fix and is currently conflicting, so automation should not create a separate repair until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace the stale candidate
options.body: Close or leave the fork PR as non-canonical and queue a fresh Feishu-owned fix with target-validation tests and live proof expectations.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to rebase and repair the existing fork branch, including the known nullable-type and proof gaps.

options.title: Wait for live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue parked until someone provides a redacted live Feishu send transcript proving the current-main failure end to end.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale candidate
recommendation.body: Close or leave the fork PR as non-canonical and queue a fresh Feishu-owned fix with target-validation tests and live proof expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community maintainer, so they are the best domain-routing candidate among the history signals.
